android.desc:
Turn your phone into a bright and eye-catching LED sign with GlowBoard.

Display large, easy-to-read messages at concerts, festivals, sports games, school events, parties, meetings, and more. Simply enter your message, customize the LED style, and show it instantly in full screen.

Key features

• Clean, ad-free experience
• Large and bright LED messages
• Custom text colors and visual effects
• Full-screen display for better visibility
• Quick and easy message editing
• High contrast for dark venues and nighttime events

Use GlowBoard to support your favorite artist, cheer for your team, display event information, welcome someone, or share a message across a crowded venue.

Turn your phone into a powerful digital sign wherever you go.

GlowBoard — Make your message shine.
